metadata.description: Sample plugins for the Operator Platform — start with hal-9001 to learn the basics, then move on to discovery-one for the advanced capabilities.

plugins.name: hal-9001
plugins.description: Minimal sample — one agent, one skill. The fastest path to seeing a plugin install on the Operator Platform.

plugins.name: discovery-one
plugins.description: Advanced sample — schedules, sub-agents, and platform tools. Every 5 minutes HAL runs the AE-35 Unit diagnostic and reports back in classic deadpan style.
